after: This version uses a modified fixed wall layout while preserving the same player and enemy initial positions.
All three walls lie completely within the main combat area.
The fixed player and enemy initial positions do not overlap any wall.

before: `WASD: Move    Mouse: Aim    Left Click: Shoot`
`R: Reload    Defeat all enemies`
after: `WASD: Move Mouse: Aim Left Click: Shoot`

before: All characters begin without overlapping each other or any wall.
after: All characters begin without overlapping each other or any of the V8 walls.
The same V8 wall rectangles are used consistently by all six systems above.

before: Player-wall collision uses axis-separated movement:
after: Player-wall collision uses the three V8 wall rectangles and axis-separated movement:

before: If the bullet spawn position overlaps a wall, the bullet disappears immediately.
after: If the bullet spawn position overlaps any V8 wall, the bullet disappears immediately.

before: - Fixed walls
- Hits a wall.
Movement uses x-first, y-second axis-separated collision.
after: Movement uses x-first, y-second axis-separated collision against the V8 walls and arena boundaries.

before: Shooter movement also uses x-first, y-second collision handling.
after: Shooter movement uses x-first, y-second collision handling against the V8 walls and arena boundaries.

before: 2. Test that segment against all fixed wall rectangles.
after: 2. Test that segment against all three V8 wall rectangles.

before: If the bullet spawn position overlaps a wall, the bullet disappears immediately.
after: If the bullet spawn position overlaps any V8 wall, the bullet disappears immediately.

before: - Hit a wall.
At initialization, the game creates the interface areas, player, 3 Chasers, 3 Shooters, 3 fixed walls, bullet lists, timers, and all state variables.
after: At initialization, the game creates the interface areas, player, 3 Chasers, 3 Shooters, the 3 V8 fixed walls, bullet lists, timers, and all state variables.

after: 2. Update player bullets and process collisions with the V8 walls, arena boundaries, and enemies. Apply enemy damage and immediately remove dead enemies.
3. Update surviving Chaser and Shooter movement using the V8 walls, Shooter firing timers, line-of-sight checks against the V8 walls, and enemy-bullet spawning.
4. Update enemy bullets and process collisions with the V8 walls, arena boundaries, and the player. Record enemy-bullet hits and remove colliding bullets.

before: - Preserve the walls.

after: - All three V8 walls to their fixed positions and sizes.

before: Walls block all character movement, all bullets, and Shooter line of sight. Other characters do not block Shooter line of sight.
after: The V8 walls block all character movement, all bullets, and Shooter line of sight. Other characters do not block Shooter line of sight.
